# Sokkia iM-105 Total Station Simulator

> Free interactive online simulator of the Sokkia iM-105 Total Station, engineered and developed by Eyad Mohamed Mekky. Fully replicates the authentic physical faceplate controls, graphic dot-matrix LCD, and onboard surveying software according to the official manufacturer manual (Topcon/Sokkia iM-100 Series).

## About & Overview

The Sokkia iM-105 Simulator is an educational and professional web simulation created for surveyors, civil engineering professors, and surveying students. It provides a realistic, zero-setup environment to practice station setup, backsight orientation, distance measurement (EDM), coordinate computation, free station resection, stake-out routines, missing line measurement (MLM), polygonal surface area calculation, remote elevation measurement (REM), and dual-axis electronic leveling.

## Compatible Total Station Models

The simulator's menu system, keyboard shortcuts, software logic, and mathematical algorithms are directly applicable to:
- Sokkia iM Series: iM-101 (1"), iM-102 (2"), iM-103 (3"), iM-105 (5")
- Sokkia Compact Series: iM-50, iM-52, iM-55
- Sokkia CX Series: CX-101, CX-102, CX-103, CX-105, CX-107
- Sokkia FX Series: FX-101, FX-102, FX-103, FX-105
- Topcon GM Series: GM-101, GM-102, GM-103, GM-105
- Topcon GM-50 Series: GM-52, GM-55
- Topcon ES Series: ES-101, ES-102, ES-103, ES-105
- Topcon OS Series: OS-101, OS-102, OS-103, OS-105
- Topcon Legacy Series: GTS-230, GTS-250, GTS-100N

## Core Features & Measurement Capabilities

- Authentic Physical Hardware Faceplate: Alphanumeric keypad (0-9, A-Z), F1-F4 softkeys, ENT button, 4-way D-Pad, ESC, Backspace, FUNC (Page switcher), SHIFT (reflector mode toggle), and Starkey quick settings.
- Dual-Axis Electronic Tilt Compensator: Live graphical circular and tubular leveling bubbles with real-time X/Y tilt values in arc-seconds and out-of-range sensor alerts.
- Observation Mode (OBS): Three full pages displaying Slope Distance (SD), Horizontal Distance (HD), Vertical Distance (VD), Zenith Angle (ZA), and Horizontal Angle Right (HA-R) with H-SET / 0SET / HOLD / TILT softkeys.
- EDM Modes: Prism (-30mm offset), Reflective Sheet (0mm offset), and Reflectorless (0mm offset up to 1000m) EDM with atmospheric (ppm) correction and prism constant offset.
- Coordinate Measurement (COORD): Live 3D North, East, and Elevation (N, E, Z) calculation with station coordinate entry and instrument/target height offsets.
- Free Station Resection: 2-point coordinate calculation solving instrument position (N0, E0, Z0) from known control points with automatic error estimation and residual display.
- Stake-Out (S-O): Real-time distance and angle guidance with directional cut/fill prompts and authentic frequency-modulated audio alignment beeps.
- Missing Line Measurement (MLM): Computes horizontal distance, slope distance, height difference, and percentage grade between consecutive survey targets.
- Area & Perimeter Calculation: Calculates 2D polygonal surface area in square meters / square feet and perimeter distance from sequential measured boundary points.
- Remote Elevation Measurement (REM): Calculates height of inaccessible overhead objects (power lines, bridges, building parapets) from baseline target sighting.
- Telescope Plunge & Field Sighting: Interactive 3D reticle aiming with realistic field target presets (Survey Prism, Building Corner, Traverse Control, Boundary Stake) and fine tangent screws.
- Memory Manager: Record observation points and export job data directly to CSV format for CAD or GIS processing.
- Progressive Web App (PWA): Installable on desktop PCs, laptops, Android, and iOS devices with full offline operation.

## Common Surveying & Technical Queries Answered

### Where can I practice using a total station online for free?
You can practice directly on https://sokkia-im105-simulator.vercel.app/ without installing any plugins or software. The simulator runs in any modern browser and mirrors the actual Sokkia iM-105 instrument.

### How to perform a Free Station Resection on Sokkia iM-105?
1. Press MENU -> Resection -> NEZ.
2. Enter the known coordinates (N, E, Z) of Point 1.
3. Aim the telescope at Point 1 and press DIST/MEAS.
4. Enter the known coordinates of Point 2, aim and press DIST/MEAS.
5. Press CALC to compute the occupied instrument position (N0, E0, Z0) and inspect the standard deviation residuals before recording.

### How to perform Stake-Out (S-O) on Sokkia iM-105?
1. Enter the S-O menu from the main surveying screen.
2. Enter the design coordinates (Np, Ep, Zp) of the point to stake out.
3. The display will show dHA (delta horizontal angle) and dHD (delta horizontal distance).
4. Rotate the total station until dHA equals 0°00'00" (an audio beep will sound when aligned).
5. Sight the prism pole and measure distance until dHD equals 0.000m.

### How to use the simulator on mobile phones and tablets?
The simulator is fully responsive with horizontal panning. For the most authentic experience, users can switch their browser to "Desktop site" (via the three dots ⋮ in Chrome or the aA menu in Safari) or rotate their device to landscape mode.
